title: Augur 155 Tech (Adventure Spec)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Yamaha Augur 155 Tech (Adventure Spec) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 155cc powertrain delivering 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 108 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
